case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent said the 90-credit estimate was three times the user's 30-credit limit.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent said "I didn't make the clip, so no credits were spent," and later confirmed it wouldn't make anything.

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The agent only offered alternatives and didn't generate them; when the user declined, nothing was made.

reply.summary: The agent met all three must-haves: it flagged the cost overrun, confirmed nothing was generated, and delivered no asset.
